characters.name: Kongssønnen
characters.description: The Prince, initially disguised in a simple sailor's outfit, is revealed to be strikingly regal and handsome. He stands taller than average, with a noble bearing. Once out of disguise, he wears a luxurious royal garment with intricate embroidery, symbolizing his true status. His hair is neatly combed, and he has a strong, distinguished jawline.

characters.name: Prinsesse
characters.description: The Princess who was once claimed to be difficult with her words. She is elegant, with a graceful posture and an expression of both surprise and curiosity. Her attire is elaborate and befitting of royalty, adorned with delicate patterns and rich fabrics. Her hair is arranged in an intricate style, enhancing her regal appearance.

characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden is depicted as clever and resourceful. He has a lean build and a twinkle of mischief in his eyes, reflecting his wit. His clothing is simple, possibly patched, showing his humble origins. He carries an assortment of odd objects like a binding, broken bowl, dead magpie, and horn, symbolizing his unique approach to challenges. He smiles triumphantly after winning the Princess.
